description: Detect sustained activity and conversation intensity from local prompt-submit events, then emit low-interruption break reminders.

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'launcher="$HOME/Library/Application Support/gentle-break-reminder/hook_launcher.py"; if [ ! -f "$launcher" ]; then launcher=$(find "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache" -path "*/gentle-break-reminder/*/scripts/hook_launcher.py" -type f -print -quit 2>/dev/null); fi; [ -n "$launcher" ] && [ -f "$launcher" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$launcher"'
